title.en: Working Conditions and Access
title.zh: 工作条件与接入

headline.en: Check whether the arrangement gives the task somewhere to happen.
headline.zh: 先核对这项工作有没有实际可用的条件。

summary.en: Explore approved tools, usable working conditions, fallback contact and information-handling support.
summary.zh: 回看获准工具、可使用的工作条件、后备联系和信息处理支持。

title.en: Remote Work Setup Readiness: Access, Resources and Support
title.zh: 远程工作条件准备：接入、资源与支持怎样核对

description.en: Review four preparation actions for remote access and working conditions. Find a small trial and separate resource constraints from personal ability.
description.zh: 通过四项行动核对远程接入与工作条件，用小试行找出支持需求，区分资源限制与个人能力。

scoreReading.en: Read four current preparation stages, including the conditions you cannot assess. A numeric mean needs all four numeric answers; it is not a remote-work pass mark.
scoreReading.zh: 回看四项当前准备阶段，包括暂时无法判断的条件。只有四项都为数值时才显示均值，它不是远程工作的合格线。

title.en: Start with a representative task
title.zh: 从一项代表性任务开始

paragraphs.en: Having a laptop and an internet connection does not establish that a particular task can be done remotely. The task may depend on approved software, access to a shared resource, a workable environment and a way to get support. This area records preparation for checking those conditions. It does not inspect your device, verify security settings or judge your home, disability access or suitability for employment.
paragraphs.zh: 有电脑和网络，还不能说明某项工作已经具备远程条件。具体任务可能需要获准软件、共享资源、适用空间和支持渠道。本组回看你为核对这些条件做过什么，不扫描设备、不检验安全配置，也不评价居住环境、无障碍需求或是否适合被录用。

title.en: Access is different from confidence
title.zh: 有信心，不等于已经能接入

paragraphs.en: You may understand a tool well but lack permission to use the project’s files. You may also have access yet need training or an accessible alternative. These are different issues with different owners. Treat an unresolved resource as a condition to discuss, rather than evidence that you are unmotivated. A successful trial of one task also does not prove that every duty in a role can be moved online.
paragraphs.zh: 会用某个工具，却没有项目文件的访问权限；或者已经能接入，却还需要培训或可访问的替代方式，这些是不同问题，处理责任也不同。应把未落实资源作为待讨论条件，不能直接归结为“不够主动”。一次任务试行成功，也不能证明岗位里的所有工作都可以远程完成。

title.en: The shared file opens for only one person
title.zh: 共享材料并没有对所有人可用

paragraphs.en: Imagine a remote research assistant rehearsing a report update. Their own account opens the draft, but a reviewer cannot access the linked source folder. The trial has uncovered a handover and permissions issue, not a general lack of digital skill. An appropriate next step is to ask the responsible person about an approved access arrangement, without copying restricted information into an unapproved service to make the rehearsal work.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，团队准备远程评审一份活动方案。发起者可以打开资料，评审者却看不到链接里的图片文件。试行暴露的是交接和权限条件，不等于谁的数字能力差。可以找负责人员确认获准的共享方式，不应为了让演练顺利就把受限资料搬到未经同意的平台。

title.en: Try an ordinary task with dummy material
title.zh: 用虚构材料试跑一个普通任务

paragraphs.en: Choose one representative task and use dummy content wherever possible. Check that you can reach the approved tool, identify the current working file and locate the support route if something fails. Rehearse notifying the team about a lost connection without actually disabling equipment or changing permissions. Note what required another person’s help and what remains unresolved. The test needs only your stage choice, not a screenshot or access credential.
paragraphs.zh: 尽量用虚构内容，选一项代表性任务，试着进入获准工具、找到当前工作文件，并确认失败时的支持渠道。可以口头演练网络中断后怎样通知团队，不必真的断网或更改权限。记录哪些步骤需要别人协助、哪些条件仍未落实。作答只需选择阶段，不要提交截图、凭据或工作资料。

title.en: Working conditions are a shared concern
title.zh: 工作条件需要共同处理

paragraphs.en: Equipment, accessibility, connectivity and a suitable place to work are not entirely individual responsibilities. The HSE source is guidance for Great Britain’s home and hybrid working context; it highlights employer consideration of resources and the working environment. It is not a universal legal rule supplied by this test. For your arrangement, identify the responsible organization or client and discuss the support needed rather than treating a self-report as a risk assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 设备、无障碍条件、网络和适用空间，并不完全由个人负责。所引HSE材料面向英国大不列颠地区的居家及混合工作情境，提醒雇主考虑资源和环境；本测试没有把它变成通用于各地的法律判断。应结合自己的安排，确认相关组织或合作方的责任与可提供支持，而不是拿自报结果替代风险评估。

title.en: Keep uncertainty visible
title.zh: 保留未能判断的条件

paragraphs.en: A numeric mean requires four numeric stage choices. If a condition is not applicable, cannot be assessed or is private, the non-rating choice withholds this group’s mean rather than scoring the condition as zero. Other groups remain available. These original action summaries are not an equipment inspection or a certification of remote readiness. Revisit the item rows when tools, permissions, location or the task changes.
paragraphs.zh: 只有四项都选择数值阶段时，本组才显示均值。条件不适用、无法判断或不愿回答时，可以选择非数值项，本组撤下均值，不会把它算作零；其他组仍可阅读。这些原创行动记录不是设备检查或远程工作认证。工具、权限、地点或任务变化后，应再核对具体条目。

title.en: Planning and Visible Progress
title.zh: 任务计划与进度可见

headline.en: Make the plan usable when nobody shares the same room.
headline.zh: 让不在同一空间的人，也能看懂工作怎样推进。

summary.en: Review completion criteria, workable plans, visible progress and what you change after trying a plan.
summary.zh: 回看完成标准、可行计划、进度可见和试行后的调整。

title.en: Remote Work Planning: Clear Outputs and Visible Progress
title.zh: 远程任务计划：明确产出，让进度可以跟进

description.en: Explore four remote planning actions and a small trial. Compare similar stage summaries without turning work hours or visibility into a performance score.
description.zh: 通过四项计划行动和一次小试行回看远程安排；理解相近阶段记录，不把在线时长或可见度当成绩效分。

scoreReading.en: Read four current preparation stages, including the conditions you cannot assess. A numeric mean needs all four numeric answers; it is not a remote-work pass mark.
scoreReading.zh: 回看四项当前准备阶段，包括暂时无法判断的条件。只有四项都为数值时才显示均值，它不是远程工作的合格线。

title.en: Define the output before filling the calendar
title.zh: 先说清产出，再安排时间

paragraphs.en: A calendar can be full while the intended output remains unclear. This area records preparation for clarifying one task’s completion criteria, allowing for dependencies, keeping agreed progress visible and reviewing a trial plan. It is about making work discussable in a particular arrangement. It does not measure concentration, conscientiousness or the amount of work you should produce in a day, and it does not require a rigid schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 日历排满了，也可能还没说清最终要交什么。本组回看完成标准、依赖条件、约定位置的进度记录和试行后的调整，目的是让一项具体安排可以讨论。它不测专注力、尽责性或每天应完成多少工作，也不要求所有人采用严格固定的日程。

title.en: Visibility is not constant availability
title.zh: 让进度可见，不等于随时在线

paragraphs.en: A shared note stating what is complete, blocked or awaiting a decision can be more useful than an always-green status indicator. Likewise, a flexible plan can be well prepared if collaborators understand what will happen next. Judge the preparation against the task and agreement, not a preferred work style. The ILO guidance emphasizes objectives, tasks and milestones without unnecessarily burdensome reporting; it does not validate a score for individual productivity.
paragraphs.zh: 一条说明“已完成、被什么阻塞、等待谁决定”的共享记录，可能比一直显示在线更有用。灵活的计划同样可以准备充分，关键是协作者是否理解下一步。应按任务和约定核对准备，而不是按偏好的工作风格打分。ILO材料强调目标、任务和里程碑，并不支持给个人的生产力贴上一个已验证分数。

title.en: A plan meets a missing dependency
title.zh: 计划遇到了未落实的依赖

paragraphs.en: Suppose a remote editor plans to finish a draft on Friday but needs a factual check from another person first. The useful preparation is to make that dependency visible, identify when it matters and discuss an alternative if it is delayed. Simply adding a longer work block does not create the missing information. The situation may require a revised output or agreement rather than a judgment about the editor’s discipline.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，远程整理培训材料时，需要业务同事先确认一组数据。可以提前写明这项依赖、何时会影响推进，以及延迟时怎样调整。单纯增加工作时长，并不能产生尚未确认的信息。此时更需要讨论产出或安排，而不是把问题直接判断为个人不自律。

title.en: Run a plan small enough to inspect
title.zh: 试行一份可以看清过程的小计划

paragraphs.en: Choose a low-stakes task or simulation and write the intended output, a next action and one dependency. Try the plan for a bounded period, then compare the plan with what happened. Put a concise update in a place agreed with a willing collaborator or rehearsal partner. Record one revision that would make the next attempt more realistic. Do not use private work data merely to make the exercise look authentic.
paragraphs.zh: 选一个低风险任务或模拟，写下产出、下一步和一个依赖条件，试行一段有起止的时间后比较计划与实际过程。在与协作者或演练同伴约定的位置放一条简短更新，再写下一处下次要调整的地方。为了显得真实而使用未获准的工作数据，并不是完成练习的条件。

title.en: Workload and authority shape the plan
title.zh: 工作量和决定权限会影响计划

paragraphs.en: A plan may be constrained by workload, changing instructions or decisions outside your control. Better preparation can include identifying a conflict and requesting clarification. It does not mean silently absorbing every change or proving that care responsibilities never interrupt the day. Where the expected work cannot fit the available conditions, discuss priorities and support with the relevant person. This test cannot determine the correct workload for you.
paragraphs.zh: 计划还会受工作量、不断变化的要求和个人无权决定的事项影响。发现冲突并提出核对，也可以是准备行动，而不是默默消化全部变化，更不是证明照护等现实安排永远不会影响工作。如果预期任务无法放进现有条件，应讨论优先级和支持。本测试不能决定你的适当工作量。

title.en: Look behind a close pair of means
title.zh: 相近均值要回到具体行动读

paragraphs.en: Four numeric choices produce a transparent, equally weighted mean from 0 to 3. Two close means may reflect different tasks, resources or unfinished steps, rather than a meaningful difference between people. The item rows and stage counts preserve that detail. A non-rating answer withholds this group’s number only. Use the result to select one planning question to revisit; it is not a deadline-reliability rating or a hiring signal.
paragraphs.zh: 四项数值选择会产生0至3的等权均值，计算方法公开。但相近均值可能对应不同任务、资源和未完成步骤，不能说明人与人之间存在实质优劣。逐题记录和各阶段计数保留了这些信息。非数值项只撤下本组数字。可以据此选择一个待核对问题，不应把它当成守时评价或招聘信号。

title.en: Handover and Decisions
title.zh: 信息交接与决策

headline.en: Give the next person enough context to take the next step.
headline.zh: 给下一位协作者足够背景，让下一步可以发生。

summary.en: Explore the preparation behind written handovers, current versions, decision requests and recorded agreements.
summary.zh: 回看书面交接、当前版本、决策请求和已约定结论的准备。

title.en: Remote Handover Preparation: Context, Decisions and Current Files
title.zh: 远程信息交接准备：背景、决定与当前文件

description.en: Review four handover actions with concrete examples. Written and live communication can both work; preparation depends on the task and agreement.
description.zh: 用具体情境回看四项交接行动；书面与实时沟通都可能适用，准备应围绕任务和共同约定。

scoreReading.en: Read four current preparation stages, including the conditions you cannot assess. A numeric mean needs all four numeric answers; it is not a remote-work pass mark.
scoreReading.zh: 回看四项当前准备阶段，包括暂时无法判断的条件。只有四项都为数值时才显示均值，它不是远程工作的合格线。

title.en: A handover connects two pieces of work
title.zh: 交接把两段工作连接起来

paragraphs.en: A handover is useful when the recipient can understand the situation and identify what to do next. This group records preparation for context, a recognizable current version, clear decision requests and a record of agreed outcomes. It does not rate your writing talent or assign you an asynchronous personality. Some issues need a live conversation; the preparation question is how the relevant understanding reaches the people who need it.
paragraphs.zh: 有效交接让接收人知道当前情况和下一步。本组回看背景说明、可辨认的当前版本、清楚的决策请求，以及已约定结论的记录。它不评价文笔，也不把人分成“异步型人格”。有些问题适合实时讨论，准备重点是相关理解怎样到达需要它的人。

title.en: More messages are not necessarily more context
title.zh: 消息更多，不一定背景更清楚

paragraphs.en: A long chat history can still omit the decision owner, the reason for a request or the version under discussion. A short structured note can also fail if the recipient lacks access or needs a conversation first. Do not treat a particular channel as automatically superior. The ILO source supports clear expectations and communication arrangements; it does not establish that one style always produces better performance.
paragraphs.zh: 很长的聊天记录，也可能漏掉由谁决定、为什么提出请求或正在讨论哪个版本。简短说明如果缺访问权限、或对方需要先沟通，也会失效。不能只凭渠道判断沟通优劣。ILO材料支持清楚的预期和沟通安排，却没有证明某一种风格总能带来更好的工作表现。

title.en: The decision is buried in the conversation
title.zh: 决定埋在了对话里

paragraphs.en: Imagine a distributed product team discussing a draft in a call. One participant thinks a choice was approved; another thinks more information was requested. Someone starting work later sees only an old document. A useful rehearsal records the agreed outcome, names what remains open and identifies the current artifact. It does not require publishing every message or recording a meeting without the participants’ agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，跨部门线上评审结束后，有人以为方案已通过，有人认为还要补材料，稍后开始工作的同事又看到了旧稿。可在演练中记录已确认结论、仍待决定的事项和当前文件位置。解决问题不要求公开全部聊天，也不要求在未经参与者同意时录制会议。

title.en: Test a handover with a fresh reader
title.zh: 请一位新读者试着接手

paragraphs.en: Use fictional material and ask a willing peer to act as the next collaborator. Give them a note with the task, necessary context, current artifact and requested next action. Ask them to explain what decision they believe is needed and by when. Compare that interpretation with your intention, then revise one confusing part. This is a rehearsal of the handover, not a test of the other person.
paragraphs.zh: 用虚构材料请愿意协助的人扮演下一位协作者。给他一条包含任务、必要背景、当前材料和下一步的说明，再请他复述需要什么决定、何时需要。比较双方理解，修改一处容易混淆的地方。这里是在试交接办法，不是在考核对方是否理解力足够。

title.en: Recipients need access and room to respond
title.zh: 接收方也需要条件和回应空间

paragraphs.en: Language, accessibility, time differences, workload and authority affect how a handover should be designed. A decision request should leave a realistic route for clarification rather than assuming an immediate response. Sensitive information may need an approved channel and a smaller audience. If those conditions are unresolved, identify the issue and ask the responsible person; a personal preference or a high self-reported stage cannot supply missing permission.
paragraphs.zh: 语言、无障碍需求、工作时段、工作量和决定权限，都会影响交接方式。提出请求时应留出可行的澄清路径，而不是默认立即回应。敏感信息还可能需要获准渠道和更小的接收范围。条件未落实时，应找相关负责人核对，偏好或较高自报阶段都不能补足缺失权限。

title.en: Treat the number as a prompt to inspect the handover
title.zh: 用数字提醒自己检查交接

paragraphs.en: The group’s mean summarizes four reported action stages when none is missing. It cannot verify whether the recipient could act on a real handover. Equal means may hide a different unresolved decision or access condition, so read the rows. All five complete preparation readings remain available when a value is withheld. No career-fit percentage or communication certification follows from this original summary.
paragraphs.zh: 没有非数值项时，本组均值概括四项自报行动阶段，却不能验证真实接收方是否已经能够行动。相同均值还可能藏着不同的决定或接入条件，应看具体条目。某组撤下数字时，各项完整指南和其他准备组仍可阅读。本原创回顾不产生职业适配百分比或沟通认证。

title.en: Help and Coordination
title.zh: 求助与协同约定

headline.en: Prepare what happens when work depends on somebody else.
headline.zh: 为工作需要别人配合的时候，准备实际办法。

summary.en: Review blocker escalation, contact windows, early dependency signals and purposeful connection.
summary.zh: 回看阻塞升级、联系时段、提前说明依赖和有目的联系。

title.en: Remote Coordination Readiness: Blockers, Contact and Support
title.zh: 远程协同准备：阻塞、联系时段与支持渠道

description.en: Explore four coordination actions and an escalation rehearsal. Asking for help and working independently can coexist; no ability score is inferred.
description.zh: 通过四项协同行动和一次求助演练核对安排。独立工作与适时求助可以并存，本结果不评定协作能力。

scoreReading.en: Read four current preparation stages, including the conditions you cannot assess. A numeric mean needs all four numeric answers; it is not a remote-work pass mark.
scoreReading.zh: 回看四项当前准备阶段，包括暂时无法判断的条件。只有四项都为数值时才显示均值，它不是远程工作的合格线。

title.en: Independence still has dependencies
title.zh: 独立工作也存在依赖

paragraphs.en: Remote work does not remove the need for decisions, feedback or help. This area records preparation for recognizing a blocker, using an agreed escalation route, checking contact windows, signalling dependencies and maintaining purposeful connection. The four items group related actions rather than exhaust every form of teamwork. A higher stage does not mean you should solve every issue alone or make yourself continuously available to others.
paragraphs.zh: 远程工作仍可能需要决定、反馈和帮助。本组通过四项行动回看阻塞升级、联系时段、依赖说明和有目的联系，并没有穷尽所有团队协作情境。阶段较高不表示应该独自解决一切，也不表示要对别人保持全天候可用。

title.en: Early help differs from constant interruption
title.zh: 及时求助，不等于不断打断

paragraphs.en: A useful escalation can name the task, what has been tried, the effect of the blocker and the decision required. It is different from either repeatedly sending an unexplained “urgent” message or silently waiting until the deadline. The appropriate route depends on the task’s urgency and the team’s agreement. Neither being sociable nor preferring solitary work establishes that those arrangements are already in place.
paragraphs.zh: 有用的求助可以说清任务、已经尝试的办法、阻塞的影响和需要的决定。它既不同于反复发送没有背景的“急”，也不同于一直不说直到临近截止。采用什么路径，要看事情的紧急程度和团队约定。喜欢社交或喜欢独处，都不能证明这些安排已经落实。

title.en: A question waits while the deadline approaches
title.zh: 问题一直悬着，截止时间却在接近

paragraphs.en: Suppose a remote analyst needs approval before including a new data source. The usual reviewer is unavailable. An agreed alternative contact or a decision to omit the source may matter more than working faster. A rehearsal can clarify when to flag the dependency, who can decide and what can safely continue meanwhile. It should not involve using restricted data or assuming that silence means approval.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，一份远程制作的宣传材料需要负责人确认一项对外表述，但常用联系人暂时不在。替代联系人或先移除该表述，可能比继续赶工更重要。演练可以明确何时提出依赖、谁有权确认，以及等待时哪些工作能安全继续，不能把沉默当成同意。

title.en: Practise a short blocker message
title.zh: 练习一条简短的阻塞说明

paragraphs.en: Choose a fictional blocked task. Write a brief message describing the expected output, the obstacle, what you have tried and the help needed. Ask a willing rehearsal partner to identify the next decision and whether the requested timing is clear. Revise the message and note an alternative route if the normal contact is unavailable. Do not create a real incident or contact an uninvolved colleague merely to complete the exercise.
paragraphs.zh: 选一个虚构的受阻任务，简短写出预期产出、障碍、已尝试内容和所需帮助。请演练同伴指出下一项决定，并核对时间要求是否清楚，再修改说明、补一个常用联系人不可用时的替代路径。无需制造真实故障，也不必为了完成练习打扰无关同事。

title.en: Connection should serve the people involved
title.zh: 联系安排应对双方有用

paragraphs.en: Check-ins can support coordination and connection, but they can also become unnecessary reporting. Agree a purpose and format that people can use, with attention to access, workload and differing work hours. The ILO guidance treats management support, tools and trust as part of effective arrangements. These conditions belong in a shared conversation, rather than being converted into a personal shortfall when a worker lacks support.
paragraphs.zh: 定期联系可能支持协作，也可能变成没有必要的汇报。可以共同确认目的和形式，并考虑接入条件、工作量与不同工作时段。ILO材料把管理支持、工具和信任也纳入安排；缺少支持时，应把问题带入共同讨论，而不是换算成个人不足。

title.en: Use the detail before comparing stages
title.zh: 比较阶段前，先看具体条件

paragraphs.en: The mean is available only for four numeric stage choices, while the item counts show which actions are drafts, trials or reviewed attempts. A withheld value does not mean low cooperation. Two equal or close means can involve different support systems and different unfinished actions. This original self-report cannot verify team relationships, assess social wellbeing or predict remote-work success; it can help you prepare one clearer coordination question.
paragraphs.zh: 四项都是数值时才显示均值；阶段计数则说明哪些行动仍是草案、已经试跑或已复盘。撤下数字不等于不善合作。相同或相近均值，可能对应不同支持体系和未完成行动。本原创自报不能验证团队关系、评估社会性健康或预测远程工作成功，但可帮助你准备一个更清楚的协同问题。

title.en: Boundaries and Sustainable Arrangements
title.zh: 离线边界与持续安排

headline.en: Make working time and stopping time part of the same arrangement.
headline.zh: 把开始工作和结束工作，都放进共同安排。

summary.en: Review contact boundaries, non-urgent messages, usable breaks and a way to discuss changed conditions.
summary.zh: 回看联系边界、非紧急消息、可用休息和条件变化后的沟通。

title.en: Remote Work Boundaries: Contact Times, Breaks and Changing Needs
title.zh: 远程工作边界：联系时段、休息与条件变化

description.en: Explore four actions for sustainable remote arrangements. Use the reading to discuss needs; it does not diagnose burnout or prescribe working hours.
description.zh: 通过四项行动回看可持续远程安排，为讨论需要提供线索，不诊断倦怠，也不规定统一工作时长。

scoreReading.en: Read four current preparation stages, including the conditions you cannot assess. A numeric mean needs all four numeric answers; it is not a remote-work pass mark.
scoreReading.zh: 回看四项当前准备阶段，包括暂时无法判断的条件。只有四项都为数值时才显示均值，它不是远程工作的合格线。

title.en: Ending work needs an arrangement too
title.zh: 结束工作也需要安排

paragraphs.en: When work and home share a location, stopping may need more explicit planning. This area records preparation for working-time boundaries, non-urgent messages, usable breaks and a discussion when conditions change. It does not determine your ideal hours or diagnose stress, fatigue or burnout. The relevant question is whether the arrangement gives you and your collaborators a workable understanding of availability, rest and what to revisit.
paragraphs.zh: 工作与生活共用一个地点时，结束工作也可能需要更明确的安排。本组回看工作边界、非紧急消息、可使用的休息和条件变化后的沟通，不决定理想时长，也不诊断压力、疲劳或倦怠。重点是你与协作者是否对可联系、休息和需要重谈的条件有可行理解。

title.en: Flexibility is different from being always on
title.zh: 灵活安排，不等于随时待命

paragraphs.en: Flexible hours can coexist with a clear response expectation. A fixed schedule can still fail if messages are treated as immediately urgent outside it. Similarly, putting a break on a calendar is different from having enough support and workload flexibility to take it. Consider both personal preparation and organizational conditions. A self-report stage cannot demonstrate that a boundary is respected simply because it has been written down.
paragraphs.zh: 弹性工作时间可以与清楚的回应预期并存；固定日程也可能因为时段之外的消息默认“马上处理”而失效。把休息写进日历，与实际有条件休息，也是两回事。应同时考虑个人准备和组织条件。写下边界以后，本测试仍不能证明它已经被双方尊重。

title.en: An ordinary message arrives after the agreed time
title.zh: 约定时段之外，来了一条普通消息

paragraphs.en: Imagine a remote support designer receiving a non-urgent revision request after their agreed contact period. The preparation issue is not whether they care enough to answer instantly. It is whether the team has a shared expectation for acknowledgement, the next response window and a separate path for genuinely urgent issues. A rehearsal may reveal that the sender and recipient had different assumptions and need to adjust the agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，约定联系时段结束后，收到一项不紧急的内容修改要求。重点不是是否足够在意工作、必须立即回复，而是双方是否约定收到消息怎样处理、下一次何时回应、真正紧急时走什么路径。一次模拟可能发现双方默认理解不同，因而需要重谈约定。

title.en: Rehearse a start, a pause and a finish
title.zh: 试演开始、暂停和结束

paragraphs.en: Sketch one trial remote day around a modest task. Include a start cue, a usable pause, an end cue and a plan for a non-urgent message that arrives later. Discuss the plan with a willing partner who can question its assumptions. After trying it, record one adjustment. This does not require disabling safety-critical notifications, ignoring urgent responsibilities or imposing the same schedule on everybody.
paragraphs.zh: 围绕一项小任务画出试行工作日，写入开始提示、能使用的暂停、结束提示，以及之后收到非紧急消息的处理方式，请愿意协助的人帮忙核对假设。试行后记下一处调整。练习不要求关闭安全相关通知、忽略紧急责任，也不要求所有人使用同一张时间表。

title.en: Changing needs belong in the conversation
title.zh: 条件变化后，应有重新讨论的路径

paragraphs.en: Caring commitments, accessibility needs, shared space and workload may change. People should not have to disclose unnecessary private details in a public test to acknowledge those constraints. Identify an appropriate way to discuss the adjustment and who can help. The HSE source concerns home workers’ conditions in Great Britain, and the ILO material is pandemic-era practical guidance; neither is a universal rule about the schedule or support you personally require.
paragraphs.zh: 照护、无障碍需求、共享空间和工作量都可能变化。承认这些限制，不需要在公开测试里披露不必要的私人细节。可以先确认怎样提出调整、由谁协助。HSE来源面向英国大不列颠地区的居家工作条件，ILO材料属于疫情时期的实践指导；它们都不能直接规定每个人应采用的日程或支持方式。

title.en: Keep the result open to revision
title.zh: 把结果留给下一次调整

paragraphs.en: This original group summarizes preparation stages, not health outcomes. A mean appears only when all four items are numeric, and equal means do not establish equivalent workloads or access to rest. If a condition is not applicable or cannot be assessed, the withheld value preserves that uncertainty. Choose a small next conversation from the item rows, and revisit the answers when the task, household conditions or working agreement changes.
paragraphs.zh: 本组概括准备阶段，而非健康结果。只有四项都是数值时才有均值，相同均值也不能说明工作量或休息条件相同。不适用或无法判断时，撤下数字是为了保留不确定性。可以从具体条目中选择下一次要讨论的事，并在任务、居家条件或工作约定改变后重新核对。
